scope: leaf word/tag mapping measured for all 8 columns and 4 row straps; BE/front mapping follows actual wires, pending native fullSM timing qualification
BE_mode3: own_y=selected scalar; own_row=GVtag[15:4]; no arithmetic; one simultaneous valid leaf required
front: rdata[32*c+:32] is column c scalar; rrow is column0 row only, namely16*leafrow+word, beat0..63. Odd-column internal row prefix64 is not present in common rrow.

two_beat_512bit_landing.packing: even beat low256, following odd beat high256
two_beat_512bit_landing.eight_contiguous_dims: requires gathering from four 512-bit landing rows; a landing row contains four heads interleaved across two dimensions and both halves

identity: blockslot, head group and epoch are compiler context; actual SM rrow has no block/head identity field
